leads.note: Taint from net/textproto Reader errors to a line-oriented log. Fixed toolchains quote the peer input in the error, so there is no version-independent part; the sink must be gated on the building toolchain, which no Go row or taint selector can express.

Untrusted relative path to os.Root.Open/OpenFile/ReadFile on an affected Unix toolchain. On fixed toolchains this is the intended confinement, so the finding is wholly toolchain-gated. Also needs request-path sources (draft bifrost-packs#225).

An assertion (ParseForm/FormValue/PostFormValue or url.ParseQuery called in a module built by an affected toolchain) needs no flow, but go-toolchain rows are constraint-only, so the range predicate is unresolved, and target-of gives no module for a Go file (topology_derivation_incomplete).

Request value concatenated into a Cmd.Env entry, then Cmd.Start/Run, on an affected Windows toolchain. Fixed toolchains reject NUL, so the finding is wholly toolchain-gated; Windows-only files also need an analysis run with GOOS=windows.
